# Sun & Earth runtime dependencies

This module includes browser ESM builds of Three.js r187 (with OrbitControls) and
Astronomy Engine 2.1.19. The local copies keep the feature buildable under its
file-ownership boundary. The upstream MIT licenses are included here.

- [Three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r187)
- [Three.js types](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@types/three/v/0.187.0)
- [Astronomy Engine](https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy)

The JavaScript files are generated by bundling their named exports with esbuild
in browser ESM mode. The Three.js declaration file bundles the corresponding
exports from `@types/three`. Astronomy Engine includes its own declarations.
